# odi-oss test fixture -- the tail of the last cmd 51 bracket of the isp2
# stock image (V1.0-220923 on the second stick, boot trace of 2026-09-21,
# steady-state window, written by the stock driver). The ring had wrapped
# (dropped=36064), so the window starts inside the VLAN sweep of the bracket, at
# row 3107; the CF rows written before it are lost.
#
# Transformed from the raw register writes, nothing else changed:
#   - a TBL_ACCESS_CTRL write (0x012000) with CMD_TYPE=write (bit 3) and
#     TBL_TYPE=1 (VLAN) becomes "T VLAN <row> <value>", ADDR from bits
#     21..9, value = the TBL_ACCESS_WR_DATA word (0x012008) held then;
#     the table reads the stock driver interleaves (CMD_TYPE=read) are dropped,
#     as is the TBL_ACCESS plumbing itself;
#   - "W <addr> <value>" kept for 0x011000-0x01cfff and 0x02a000-0x02afff
#     (the switch core); the interrupt, I2C and GPON writes other code
#     interleaves (0x01d00c, 0x01d010, 0x023008, 0x7xxxxx, 0x0000bc/c4)
#     are dropped;
#   - consecutive rows with one value folded to "T VLAN <a>..<b> <value>";
#   - cut after the last row of the bracket, 4094 of the second VLAN pass.
